messages.content: You label synthetic SentiLab fixture records. Return only JSON with keys result, lifecycle, repair. Copy the verifier lifecycle, map accepted to success, rejected_constraints or rejected_schema to rejection, failed_run or reproduction_failed or cancelled or inconclusive to failure, non_improving_current or within_margin or non_improving to non_improving, tie to tie. repair is the provided repair label or null. This is a fixture metadata task, not a thermal or geometry prediction.

For this preflight label check, emit the JSON object.
